title: Towards Trustworthy AI-Enabled Emergency Medical Dispatch: Uncertainty-Aware Ambulance Travel Time Estimation
abstract: arXiv:2610.31944v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Emergency medical dispatch increasingly relies on AI-enabled decision support systems when making ambulance dispatch decisions. In this process, accurate ambulance travel time estimates are essential for timely resource allocation and prehospital care. However, existing ambulance travel time estimation approaches typically produce only single point predictions. Consequently, they do not indicate how reliable an individual estimate is or how much uncertainty it carries. This limitation is particularly problematic in safety-critical emergency medical service dispatch operations, where trips with similar expected travel times may exhibit substantially different levels of uncertainty. Furthermore, real-world ambulance trip logs may contain domain-specific artefacts, such as co-located healthcare facilities and physically implausible travel speeds. translated_title: 迈向可信赖的AI赋能紧急医疗调度：不确定性感知的救护车行程时间估计
translated_abstract: 紧急医疗调度在做出救护车派遣决策时日益依赖AI赋能的决策支持系统。在此过程中，准确的救护车行程时间估计对于及时的资源配置和院前救护至关重要。然而，现有的救护车行程时间估计方法通常仅产生单一点预测。因此，这些方法无法表明单个估计结果的可靠程度或其所含不确定性的大小。这一局限在安全攸关的紧急医疗服务调度操作中问题尤为突出，因为预期行程时间相近的行程可能表现出截然不同的不确定性水平。此外，真实世界的救护车行程日志可能包含特定领域的异常数据，例如位置重叠的医疗机构以及物理上不合理的行驶速度。这些异常会降低点预测的准确性，并影响预测任务本
tldr: 该论文提出一种不确定性感知的救护车行程时间估计方法，通过量化每次估计的不确定性并处理真实数据中的领域特定异常，提升AI辅助紧急医疗调度的可信赖性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an uncertainty-aware ambulance travel time estimation approach that quantifies the uncertainty of individual predictions and handles domain-specific data artefacts, moving toward trustworthy AI-enabled emergency medical dispatch.
